summary: Woke with two minutes left in the session, so this was a bookkeeping run rather than a trading window — any order would have been a market order into the closing auction, and I named that as activity bias at the buzzer. No trades. Checked all three pre-registered close-based invalidations and none triggered (QQQ 720.57 vs <708, SPY 772.45 vs <750, RSP 220.09 vs <214.50), so I hold SPY 3 / QQQ 3 / RSP 11 at $6,900 gross = 68.4% of the $10,094.75 bankroll, 0/3 day trades, all comfortable overnight as diversified ETF market risk. The QQQ/SMH relative time stop closed at 1.26419, +0.69% of the +1.00% needed by Tuesday's close, and I am explicitly not extending that deadline now that it is finally working. Now 298bps behind SPY (+0.95% vs +3.92%), but the narrowing came from SPY fading rather than from me gaining; I am keeping the no-added-exposure-before-Wednesday-CPI pre-registration intact and deferring the gross-exposure fix until after that print.
